inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped scheduler projection wraps GROUP_CONCAT with SUBSTRING_INDEX using a negative count to select the final concatenated label.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored service-label summary. Fixed service rows are grouped by team, labels are concatenated in deterministic priority order, and SUBSTRING_INDEX with a negative count selects the final label; the schema, rows, aliases, and reporting purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Team 11 has three labels so negative-index extraction must return the lowest-priority label; team 22 has one label to exercise the single-element boundary; team 33 has no service rows and is absent from the grouped result.
determinism_notes: Team IDs, service priorities, labels, aggregate ordering, and final ordering are fixed; labels contain no comma separators, and no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE team_services (service_id INT PRIMARY KEY, team_id INT NOT NULL, service_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, priority INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT team_id, GROUP_CONCAT(service_label ORDER BY priority DESC, service_id ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS ordered_labels, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(service_label ORDER BY priority DESC, service_id ASC SEPARATOR ','), ',', -1) AS final_label FROM team_services GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY team_id
